'''Chris Mckune''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 San Jose tournament (17 June)]] on 17 June 2000 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC Cloud Cars]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d910">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-san-jose-ca-6-18d910/ san-jose-ca-6-18], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 19 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-san-jose-ca-6-18d910/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
